# Kynomesh

> Kynomesh runs multi-agent systems on Kubernetes. An AgentSet declares the agents, the routing pattern between them (Supervisor, Handoff, Sequential) and the entry agent. A controller deploys each agent with a broker sidecar that speaks A2A.

## Start here

- [Quick start](https://kyno.sh/stable/quick-start/): install Kynomesh and run a first AgentSet.
- [Overview](https://kyno.sh/stable/core-concepts/overview/): architecture and how the pieces fit.

## Core concepts

- [AgentSet](https://kyno.sh/stable/core-concepts/agentset/): patterns, entry agent, topology.
- [AgentDeploy](https://kyno.sh/stable/core-concepts/agentdeploy/): one agent's pods, container and broker.
